name: DEN Networks Limited
summary: DEN Networks Limited, a media and entertainment company, engages in the distribution of television channels to households through a digital cable distribution network in India. The company operates in Cable and Broadband segments. It distributes and promotes television channels; and provides visual entertainment through cable TV, over-the-top entertainment, and broadband services, as well as offers internet services. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
